name: compare: the window's own answer (not a memory hit) never starts the compare
why: windowKick also runs when the answer the window waited for lands (Space before the card had read the page). Not visible to a fixture: every spec opens the window from a card, which has read the page already, so Space takes the memory-hit path (also kicked, pinned by the entry above). A spec that pressed Space before the card's read landed would cover it; the rate gate makes that timing unreliable.

name: compare: the album version compares with itself (a needless request)
why: The album version has nothing to compare with. Its own version is unlinked on the site (no href), which with !pick.self keeps it out; both guards are dropped here.
